connector.name: MCP Facturacion Electronica Es
connector.registryDescription: Spanish e-invoicing MCP server: VERI*FACTU, Facturae/FACe, SII, Crea y Crece B2B.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-facturacion-electronica-es. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cmendezs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: AEAT_ENV
env.description: Target environment for AEAT endpoints: 'sandbox' or 'production'.

env.name: AEAT_CERTIFICATE_PATH
env.description: Filesystem path to the FNMT-RCM PKCS#12 certificate (.p12 / .pfx) used for MTLS submission to AEAT (VERI*FACTU and SII).

env.name: AEAT_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD
env.description: Passphrase for the PKCS#12 certificate at AEAT_CERTIFICATE_PATH.

env.name: AEAT_NIF
env.description: Taxpayer NIF used as the default submitter identity for AEAT submissions.

env.name: FACE_ENV

env.name: FACE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: JWT client ID for FACe B2B REST API v2.

env.name: FACE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: JWT client secret for FACe B2B REST API v2.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Logging level inherited from mcp-einvoicing-core: DEBUG, INFO (default), WARNING, or ERROR.
